annotations.title: Read a North Carolina (NC) General Statutes section

description:
Full text of one North Carolina (NC) General Statutes section, by citation.

Use for "what does G.S. 14-72.1 say". Accepts any spelling — "14-72.1", "G.S. 14-72.1",
"§ 14-72.1". Returns catchline, body, history note, and when it was first enacted and
last amended. `as_of` gives the text observed on a past date; `pending` lists variants
enacted but not yet effective.

`as_of` RESOLVES AGAINST OBSERVED VERSIONS, NOT EFFECTIVE DATES — it answers "what did
this database hold on that date", so it cannot reach text from before the first ingest
run. For "what took effect on 1 October" use recent_law_changes(source="effective").

Section-level only — ask for "20-141", not "20-141(j1)". For WHEN it changed use
amendment_history; for WHAT changed use diff_statute.

citation.description: One NC General Statutes SECTION. Any spelling works; subsections do not — ask for 20-141, not 20-141(j1).
